positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- MBSE Team Lead for Security, Infrastructure, Rapid Automation and Provisioning
- Developer for Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
- Deployed hardened IaaC deployments using Terraform and Ansible for clustered service deployment on AWS
- Deployed containerized (in-house and COTS) services on kubernetes platforms (Tanzu, Openshift)
- Transitioned existing services into docker containers
- Developing for the capabilities of large-scale model-based systems engineering for Engineers using industry-leading modeling software (Cameo/MSOSA, 3DX, Mentor Graphics)
- Working with company “pathfinder” projects from continuous integration and development (CI/CD), infrastructure, architecture, integration and development
- Enterprise infrastructure integration setup using Apache Tomcat, Cassandra clusters, Teamwork Cloud clusters, Postgres SQL databases
- Continuous development configuration using Git, Gitlab-CI, Ansible Tower playbooks and Jenkins pipelines
- Plugin development for COTS software using Java
- Led development for structural analysis tools written in Java
- Utilized existing CICD (Git, Jenkins pipelines and master/slave build machines) for testing, prototyping, and release
- Developed authentication and authorization tools web software systems written in C# and Java
- Daily usage of Agile best practice frameworks and methodology
